method: Single independent worker; no delegation, model/API calls, or GUI. Visually compared all 73 actual crops with all 19 authoritative source pages. Inspected every complete crop and its four native-pixel edge strips; used smaller native-resolution sheets when a combined sheet would be reduced, and enlarged tight/ambiguous details. Pillow proved all 73 images pixel-identical to their manifest rectangles. Fresh pdftoppm 300-dpi renders of PDF pages 69-78 proved all 19 source PNGs pixel-identical to their indexed spread halves. No source or candidate image was altered.
common_pass_checks: Only intended example ink apart from incidental scan specks; source-printed number (or documented continuation/analysis-part exception), variants, attribution, complete notation, lowest stems, analysis, and staff ends retained. All four edges inspected for foreign partial marks. Genuine source whitespace retained on feasible edges; no fabricated border, prose, header, footer, printed page number, or handwriting. Source paths, manifest number/caption/page, and verified-text visual-slot mapping agree. This review verifies visual slots, not the prose transcription or a chapter integration not yet performed.

proposals.note: No safe single-rectangle replacement exists for the eight source-limited failures while retaining all required content. proposed_rect is null, not an untested guess. Enlarged source-context and edge crops were made only under /tmp/opencode/m04-visual-137-155/; no erasure or artificial border was used.
